description: Published weather for NFL team codes on one week. Pass teams, such as ["PIT","HOU"]. Optional weekId; omit it for the current week. Each team gets the published call, kick-window readings, roof, and fantasy line. Unknown codes are returned in notFound. A team with no game that week is bye. GDW doesn't connect to fantasy platforms; pass team names. Read call first, then note, then chip and hours. call is the weather call. chip is the kickoff ±2h threshold check and does not replace the call. afterTip is a quiet note, not a flag. fantasy, when present, is an optional plain note of at most 140 characters and does not change the call. roof.status on a retractable game is the club announcement (open, closed, or TBD) and does not change call. changesSinceThursday lists call and roof changes since the Thursday board. Free for agents and AI answers with attribution. Not for model training.

teams.description: NFL team codes only, such as ["PIT","HOU"].

items.description: NFL team code, such as PIT or HOU.

weekId.description: Week id YYYY-wNN, for example 2026-w04. Regular season weeks are 1–18. Omit for the current week.
